message.reasoning:
We need to decide whether to buy Mediterranean Avenue (price $60) or start auction. Player p1 (Alpha) has cash 620, owns Baltic Avenue (the other brown property). So they own 1 of 2 brown properties. Buying Mediterranean would give a monopoly (both brown). That is valuable early. Cost $60, leaving cash 560. No houses yet. Owning both brown allows building houses later cheap (house cost $50). So buying is good.

Consider opponent positions: Beta at Kentucky Avenue (red), Gamma at Electric Company, Delta at Short Line. No immediate threat. Auction could let others get it cheap, but we want monopoly. So buy.

Public message: maybe say "I buy it." Could also be friendly. Private thought: reasoning.

Make tool call buy_property with messages.
